column16:
This includes the total number of notices received during the reporting period through our European Union ("EU") Illegal Content Reporting Form. Following methodology improvements, this figure now also captures intellectual property ("IP") notices submitted by EU users via our IP reporting forms for copyright and trademark reports, which are available through our EU illegal content reporting form.

Please note the total number of notices received does not equal the total numbers outlined in the rows below. This is because one notice can contain multiple items with separate reporting reasons per item. When one notice includes multiple reporting reasons, we count them separately.

column20:
The median time to take action is calculated based on the time the notice was received until the time each item was addressed. This excludes items that resulted in a decision not to take action after determining no violation was found and the content was not illegal. In situations where we did not receive any notices related to a specific category or subcategory, or we did not take any actions pursuant to those notices received in that category or subcategory, the median time is listed as 0 - as it applies to Pinterest - but the result of that practice during the reporting period is zero.

The median time is indicated in hours.

column1: Only for providers of hosting services, including online platforms
column16:
This category encompasses notices received through our European Union Illegal Content Reporting Form for “nudity or pornography” and “other.” 

In our European Union Illegal Content Reporting Form, users can select “nudity or pornography” as a reporting basis. We have included this option under this category because there is no more suitable category available on this tab for such reports.

Of the 3,137 total notices received, 423 related to “nudity or pornography” and 2,714 utilised the "other" reporting option.
